summary: Iteration 13: verified interactive Leaflet map + city-scoped new-project notification. All backend (3/3) and frontend map/notif flows pass. Cleanup done — catalog stays at 12 projects.
critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoint exists for /api/developer/projects/{id} — tester had to clean up via MongoDB directly. Consider adding one for admin/developer to remove obsolete projects.

Two duplicated CITY_COORDS tables (backend/geo.py + frontend/ProjectsMap.js). Consider exposing a single /api/geo/cities endpoint or embedding coords once on the project record (already the case for projects — good).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary project 'TEST_MapNotifSemarang' during notification test; deleted via MongoDB after assertions. Catalog verified back at 12 projects / 49 units.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /api/projects returns lat/lng for all 12 projects. New-project notif verified positive (Semarang consumer got 'Proyek baru di kota Anda 🏠') and negative (Bekasi consumer did NOT). Frontend: 12 leaflet-marker-icons anonymously; when consumer5 logs in, header shows 'perumahan terdekat dari Semarang', blue circleMarker (#2563eb) at Semarang, one orange pin (#C2410C) on nearest (Harmoni Land Semarang), popup 'Lihat Unit' navigates to /proyek/{id}. Nav bell shows unread count 2 with 'Proyek baru' notification. NOTE: leaflet markers overlap so Playwright direct .click() may be intercepted by neighbor SVG circle — use bounding_box + mouse.click at top of pin, or dispatch synthetic MouseEvent. NOTE: no DELETE /developer/projects/{id} endpoint — clean up via db.projects.delete_many if you create test projects.
